events.text: Dickson was born in Plymouth, Devon, England.

events.quote: Dickson was born on 30 November 1832 in Plymouth , Devon , England .

events.text: Dickson arrived in Australia during the Victorian gold rush.

events.quote: Dickson arrived in Australia in 1854 during the Victorian gold rush .

events.text: Dickson moved to the Colony of Queensland.

events.text: Dickson was made Secretary for Public Works and Mines under Arthur Macalister.

events.text: Dickson was appointed Minister for Defence in the first federal ministry under Edmund Barton.
